description: Normalized design tree together with its tokens. maxDepth cuts the tree by depth (0 — the root only); truncated nodes get childrenOmitted. Hidden nodes are not returned without includeHidden.

docId.description: Document id as returned by vault_list

includeHidden.description: Also return nodes hidden in Figma (hidden: true) — optional component slots. Defaults to false: building the screen as it looks does not need them.

maxDepth.description: How many levels below the root to return. Omit for the whole tree.

name: vault_get_doc
title: Whole document
